prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square 1254 x 1254 Mappa Mundi source illustration, no labels or border. Match supplied local Mappa Mundi imagery before outside inspiration. Exact same antique warm parchment, fine sepia ink, miniature medieval manuscript map drawing, subtle transparent pale stone and dusty terracotta, faint green open field. Ink and parchment dominate, not a full-color scene. No saturation increase. First attached image is the COMPOSITION GUIDE: its silhouette is the required scene composition, not a palette or rendering reference. Remaining images supply STYLE only; do not inherit their tile outline. Need organic buildings/walls within guide footprint, not flat colored geometry. Read this as an overhead map with small consistent oblique cartographic buildings, no horizon. Native architecture proportions and individually varied houses. No copied stamps, repeating towers, clipped buildings, collage, dark perimeter frame, margins or captions. Keep the last 40 pixels near exits quiet so later tiny deterministic socket correction does not move buildings. Exact pixels are handled later; this source must already be close in COMPOSITION. All four tile corners and feature contacts matter. Single output, not a grid.
SCENE: North=Settlement, East=River, South=Field, West=River. A continuous pale desaturated blue RIVER crosses WEST to EAST, centered at y50% on both side edges, about20% tile width, gentle controlled banks almost horizontal near the outer edges. River never breaks or is bridged. A modest coherent hamlet occupies a downward-curving NORTH CAP: houses/stone yards across entire top edge from top-left to top-right corners, urban frontier curves inward from those corners to touch the NORTH BANK at CENTER. The hamlet is broad at the very top but does NOT extend down the left/right edges to the water. There are open parchment/grass wedges between side edges and the hamlet north of the river. Crucially show small pale-stone dwellings with terracotta roofs and household yards, not a forest village. At most TWO small isolated trees total, a few reeds, NO woodland canopy, NO tree border, no dark green masses. Central houses front the riverbank, clearly touching water. No port/docks/warehouse/crane, no boats needed, no roads. South of water is quiet open field all the way to bottom. Keep outer river banks sparse smooth ink and watercolor, no stones/trees/objects in last40px. River the primary organizing element.
Variant: softly curving walls/banks, fine sparse hatching and restrained small-scale buildings.
reference_limit_note: Tool accepts at most five references; omitted redundant style reference before generation.
